name: Final Project & Next Steps
equipment: A computer with Python 3 installed (or an online REPL like replit.com)
instructions: This lesson covers final project & next steps.
Combine everything you've learned — functions, data structures, files, and classes — into one project of your own.
Pick an idea you care about (a habit tracker, a budget tool, a game) and build a first working version.
Once it works, look into what you'd want to learn next: web frameworks, data science, or automation.
Type the example into a real Python file (or REPL), run it, then modify it until you understand why it behaves that way.
